owner_request: 2026-10-09 Notion #44: after v1-v3 were rejected the recommendation was to stop buying the touch and wait for the drop to stop, with the stop under the low (the owner's sample: entry about 2411 near the 2405 low, stop 2396, target 2491); owner: 开始.
question: If the HTF-line reversion trade waits for a confirming close after the far touch and puts the stop just beyond the excursion's extreme, does it earn more than matched random entries after 0.2% cost, in both periods?
prior_evidence: v1-v3 (touch entries) rejected: no selection survived its check period; on OKX ETH the first year's best lost 45.6% in the second year and all of the first year's top 10 lost. ETH's 5m distance from the 15m EMA120 reached -31% and +18.7% in two years, so touch entries are run over.

5.line: EMA120 of completed 15m closes, first-close seed per contiguous run, ready after 1200 contiguous bars (V13.1 f_m15Ema120)

15.line: SMA60 of completed 1h closes, ready after 60 contiguous bars (V13.1 f_h1Sma60)

line_timing: a chart bar inside HTF bucket B reads the line of HTF bar B-1 (V13.1 knownAverage[1] with lookahead_on); missing B-1 -> no line

atr.trigger: line -/+ k * Wilder ATR14 of the same completed HTF bar as the line

pctl.trigger: long line*(1+Q_q(low/line-1)), short line*(1+Q_{1-q}(high/line-1)) over the completed chart bars of the previous 30 days (half the window required); the quantile must lie beyond the line

excursion: an excursion starts at the first touch and ends at the first chart-bar close back within half the trigger distance of the line (close >= line - D/2 for longs); no line ends it; entries need no open position on that side (sides are separate books) and skip an excursion that starts while a trade is open
confirm_rule: reclaim = a chart-bar close back beyond the trigger; prev_bar = a chart-bar close beyond the previous chart bar's high (long) / low (short); at or after the touching chart bar, no later than the excursion's last bar; entry at the next chart bar's open
stop_rule: the excursion's extreme from the touch through the confirming bar (long: lowest low) minus 0.1% of it; a fill at or beyond the stop waits for the next confirmation
reentry_rule: arm 0: one trade per excursion; arm 3: after a stop, the next confirmation inside the same excursion with the extreme recomputed from the touch, at most 3 more
book: one open trade per side; a confirmation whose entry bar is not after the last exit is skipped and the excursion stays eligible
exit_path: 5m high/low from the open entry bar; a gap through the stop or target fills at the open; stop first when both print in one bar; after 576 bars (48h) exit at that close; a missing bar before the exit drops the trade

controls.pool: same symbol, chart timeframe and calendar month, 5m bars with a ready line, HTF ATR / price within 0.5-2x the trade's
controls.entry: open of the pool bar, same side, same stop fraction as the trade, same R target, cap and cost

pass_bar: check period: mean net > 0 and mean excess > 0 with month-block sign-flip p < 0.01 (p < 0.05 = worth forward observation only)
data: frozen Binance USD-M 5m series (data/research/spike_v128_entry_clock_long_20260923/series), complete-bucket resampling
selection: per chart x side x re-entry arm x confirmation, the cell (distance measure x level x target) with the highest t of mean excess among cells with >= 30 select-period trades; its check-period numbers are the read
